scenarios.scenario_name: Competing Nearby Stores & Distance Detour Trade-off
scenarios.data_source: Tehran Road Network Distance Matrix (Simulated Trip)
hard_constraints: Provide transparent trade-off explanation of time saved vs money spent
reasons: Store A saves 35 minutes of traffic for a 700,000 Toman premium
Customer weighted travel convenience higher than marginal price savings
scenarios.uncertainty: Travel times subject to real-time traffic conditions

alternatives_rejected.alternative: Force cheapest store regardless of distance
alternatives_rejected.reason: Incurs 38-minute congested detour for marginal 3.8% savings

scenarios.scenario_name: Incomplete Basket with Honest Missing-Item Accounting
hard_constraints: Never claim 100% basket coverage when items are missing
Do not hallucinate a store carrying nonexistent items
candidate_options: Return partial plan with honest missing list
reasons: پوشش 1 قلم از 2 قلم کالا با مراجعه به «روورا نوینا» (اقلام مفقود در کل کاتالوگ فروشگاه‌ها ناموجود هستند). اقلام «کابل_تخصصی_ناموجود_در_بازار_xyz_99» در سقف توقف مشخص‌شده تامین نشدند.
scenarios.uncertainty: Catalog export limit (300 items/shop) means item could theoretically exist in physical shop unlisted

alternatives_rejected.reason: Violates truthfulness and risks customer traveling for missing item

scenarios.scenario_name: Merchant Fairness: Conflicting Customer vs Merchant Evidence

inputs.merchant_defense: Customer bought optional accessory on separate invoice

hard_constraints: Unverified complaints cannot dock merchant Bayesian score
Shops cannot be excluded from search/routing without verified evidence
reasons: Case status held as TRIAGED pending third-party operator or receipt verification
Merchant explanation recorded in auditable event log without automatic dismissal
scenarios.uncertainty: Factual truth unknown pending document/receipt audit

alternatives_rejected.alternative: Automatically penalize merchant upon customer report
alternatives_rejected.reason: Violates merchant procedural fairness and enables competitor sabotage

scenarios.scenario_name: Seller Daily Interruption Quota & Fatigue Exhaustion
hard_constraints: Enforce hard daily inquiry cap of 15 per shop to prevent merchant churn
reasons: Shop has reached its daily safe threshold of 15 inquiries

alternatives_rejected.reason: Causes seller fatigue, increases response latency, and risks merchant opt-out

decision.preservation_summary: اقلام پایه رومیزی تی وی جک از فروشگاه‌های معتبر قبلی حفظ شدند.

reasons: 🔄 برنامه خرید بازنگری شد: با توجه به عدم موجودی کالا در فروشگاه «آویسا فرسا»، کالای ماوس دل MS111 باسیم از فروشگاه «آوآرا دیسیلا» به قیمت 729,000 تومان تامین شد. اقلام پایه رومیزی تی وی جک از فروشگاه‌های معتبر قبلی حفظ شدند. مجموع هزینه جدید: 3,149,000 تومان در قالب 2 توقف فروشگاهی.
scenarios.uncertainty: Replacement store inventory subject to confirmation

alternatives_rejected.reason: Wastes verified items and disrupts customer schedule
